grouping_note: no replicate or session metadata exists, so each file is its own group; cross-validated estimates are optimistic under session effects
holdout: none (no replicate groups exist to hold out)
role_convention: fold_rN is the fold the file belongs to in repeat N; role_rN=test means the file is the held-out test file when that fold is evaluated, and trains_in_folds_rN lists the folds of repeat N whose training set it belongs to (K-fold: every pool file is tested exactly once per repeat). cnn_inner_val_rN lists the folds of repeat N whose inner validation split (carved from the outer training set at train time, used for early stopping and temperature scaling) this file was drawn into; per-epoch detail is in logs/deep_training_log.jsonl
split_randomisation: folds are re-randomised on every run from seed + repeat; this file is the authoritative record of THIS run's split and is rewritten into every run directory
